company.name: Syrup Tech
company.shortDescription: Predictive software for inventory decision-making in commerce, powered by AI/ML.
company.description: Syrup Tech is a machine-learning decision-support engine for inventory in commerce. The company uses advanced demand forecasting and stochastic optimizations. Syrup Tech's software empowers brands and retailers to significantly increase full-priced inventory sell-through by (1) preventing stock-outs and end-of-season markdowns, (2) decrease unnecessary excess inventory and reduce overproduction, and (3) reduce the time spent on manual tasks for stretched merchandising and planning teams.

productsAndServices.description: AI-driven models predict product demand by analyzing multiple internal and external data sources to improve accuracy and granularity of forecasts.
productsAndServices.name: AI Demand Forecasting

productsAndServices.description: Optimization algorithms recommend inventory allocations and replenishment strategies to align supply with predicted demand while respecting brand-specific constraints.
productsAndServices.name: AI Inventory Optimization
